scripts.a64:build: asc src/a64/index.ts -o build/a64/translator.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd && asc src/a64/helpers.ts -o build/a64/helpers.wasm -O2 --runtime stub --enable simd --enable relaxed-simd --disableWarning 112
scripts.a64:guests: npm run -s a64:build && npm run -s a64:guests:build && node test/a64/guests_run.ts; a=$?; echo '--- again with budget=50 (forced preemption) ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --budget 50 --quiet; b=$?; echo '--- again without wasm tail calls ---'; node test/a64/guests_run.ts --notail --quiet; c=$?; exit $((a|b|c))
scripts.a64:browser: npm run -s a64:build && esbuild test/a64/browser/worker.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/a64/browser/worker.js --log-level=warning && node test/a64/browser/run.ts --speed
scripts.a64:big: npm run -s a64:build && python3 test/a64/guests/build.py --big && node test/a64/guests_run.ts --dir test/a64/guests/out_big --speed --mem
